verdict.rationale: Qapita's own materials claim a financial-reporting module that generates audit-ready, compliant stock-comp expense reports, explicitly naming ASC 718 alongside IFRS and Ind AS. This maps directly to the story, but the evidence is only marketing-level taglines. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the ASC 718 report contents and exports (e.g., expense schedules, forfeiture handling, auditor-ready outputs), and independent or hands-on corroboration that auditors accept the reports.
